q: Floquet theory for periodic ODEs ẋ = A(t)x with A(t+T)=A(t) gives:
opts: All solutions are periodic with period T
The monodromy matrix M=Φ(T) (fundamental matrix at time T) determines stability via its eigenvalues (Floquet multipliers)
The system can always be reduced to a constant-coefficient system by a linear change of variables
exp: Floquet theory: the Floquet multipliers (eigenvalues of the monodromy matrix) determine stability — multipliers inside the unit circle mean stability, outside mean instability. The system can be transformed to autonomous form by a time-periodic change of variables.
